initialExam.title: OICL AO 2026 (Oriental Insurance Company)
initialExam.description: OICL Administrative Officer recruitment for generalist and specialist AO posts. OICL is a leading public sector general insurance company in India.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduate from a recognized university with 60% marks
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 marks + Descriptive. Interview: 30 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.careerGrowth: AO → Manager → Sr Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit orientalinsurance.org.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, NPS, Gratuity
